definition.ctrl: expected wins above replacement over his first 6 seasons above it, whenever they come, from his card today; replacement = the best hitter / starter / reliever not on an MLB roster that season, measured in the DEV league; learned from every DEV player who came through a draft class, scored on this league's rows
definition.q90: the 90th percentile of the same (upside); never below ctrl
definition.now: his current WAA the models start from (neutral park)

model.trained_on: DEV league, 483 dumps; rows: every player who came through a DEV draft class, all his seasons at 16-26
